title: Bounded owner-host enrollment and channel
why: Owner JWT management, exact possession-only redemption and dedicated host capability channel; no actor authority from JSON, no native credentials or qualification.

value.description: Host generated capability, authenticating only the exact hello/poll/GO/answer routes. Never actor JWT or native credentials.
Exact N answer vocabulary, plus final S identity/current-rights/budget validation. Total UTF8 wire <=65536 bytes; no generic settle bypass.

post.description: Default-OFF enrollment; owner JWT management and dedicated capability channel are disjoint. All responses no-store; 65536 UTF8 byte limits and fixed safe errors. Declaration is not qualification.
